reason: Both correctly explain that heat-pump dryers run cooler and longer and neither makes unsupported fault claims, but Conversation 1 engages further: it elicits the programme, filter history and the cold garage, correctly names the 8-10C garage as the main factor, and reassures on the jumping time display. Conversation 2 is a correct but generic one-shot that never learns about the location and only offers the 'damp at end' criterion. Conversation 1 is marked down for nagging the homeowner to re-rinse a condenser already confirmed clean, for an inappropriate 'suitable replacement' part panel when no part is needed, and for never explicitly asking if clothes are dry or warning against opening the door mid-cycle, so the margin is only slight.
